entities.name: DRONE
entities.rationale: Drone device collecting telemetry and sending data to Third Party and S3.

entities.name: THIRD PARTY
entities.rationale: External third-party platform connected to the drone.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket receiving data from Drone and Storage Gateway, and feeding back to Server.

entities.name: STORAGE GATEWAY
entities.rationale: AWS Storage Gateway connecting local server/database workloads to S3.

entities.name: SERVER
entities.rationale: Server component part of the local Server/Database block.

entities.name: DATABASE
entities.rationale: Database component part of the local Server/Database block.

entities.name: CLOUDWATCH EVENTS
entities.rationale: Amazon CloudWatch Events capturing events adjacent to vertical divider.

entities.name: STEP FUNCTIONS
entities.rationale: AWS Step Functions state machine invoked by CloudWatch Events.

entities.name: LAMBDA
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function invoked by Step Functions pointing back to the left section.

visual_connections.description: Drone communicates directly with Third Party platform.
Drone sends data to Amazon S3 across vertical section divider.
Storage Gateway syncs local data to Amazon S3 bucket.
Server within the Server/Database block sends data to Storage Gateway.
Amazon S3 feeds data back to the Server/Database block.
CloudWatch Events triggers AWS Step Functions workflow.
Step Functions state machine invokes AWS Lambda function.
Lambda arrow points to the left section (towards Third Party / Drone area).
